content.text: In Zimbabwe, a country where Stripe is unavailable, digital creators face significant barriers to [[LINK:https://[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-what-nobody-tells-10|The COREMERCH]].github.io/store/blog/selling-notion-templates-crypto-what-actually-how-works-5|selling]] ebooks, courses, and digital products online. This post assumes you're one of them, frustrated with payment platforms that lock you out, and you're looking for a sovereign infrastructure solution that empowers you to accept crypto payments without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or other restricted platforms. You're about to learn how to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/build-crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-until-you|COREMERCH guide to build]] a digital store on Cloudflare Pages that's both free and secure, using the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) as a reference point for a more advanced infrastructure setup.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The current state of digital commerce infrastructure is restrictive, with many platforms imposing arbitrary limitations on what creators can sell, where they can sell it, and how they receive payments. Cloudflare Pages, as a sovereign infrastructure solution, allows you to deploy a digital store that's not beholden to any single platform or payment processor. By leveraging GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, you can create a decentralized payment and delivery pipeline that puts you in control of your own commerce stack.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy your digital store on Cloudflare Pages, you'll need to set up a few essential tools. First, create a Cloudflare account and a GitHub account. Next, install the Cloudflare Workers SDK and the NOWPayments SDK on your GitHub repository. Finally, configure your Cloudflare Pages settings to enable Workers and integrate NOWPayments. With these tools in place, you can start building your digital store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to configure NOWPayments to accept crypto payments on your behalf. This involves integrating your Cloudflare Pages site with the NOWPayments API, setting up a payment gateway, and configuring your delivery pipeline to store orders in Supabase. With this pipeline in place, you can start processing transactions and delivering your digital products to customers.
With Cloudflare Pages, you can deploy a digital store that's not beholden to any single platform or payment processor.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Testing before promotion is not optional — it is the step that determines whether your store functions correctly under real conditions before real buyers encounter it. The test sequence has four steps. First: deploy the backend and confirm the webhook endpoint returns a valid response to a test HTTP POST. Second: configure the storefront and confirm the checkout displays correctly on desktop and mobile. Third: complete a real mainnet transaction with a small amount of actual crypto. Fourth: check your order database and confirm the order was logged correctly, the delivery email arrived, and the download link works.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your digital store grows in popularity, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to keep up with demand. This involves upgrading your Cloudflare Pages plan, configuring your Workers settings for load balancing, and integrating your Supabase database with a scalable delivery pipeline. With these measures in place, you can ensure that your digital store remains fast, secure, and reliable, even as it grows in size.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages? Absolutely, but you'll need to set up a payment and delivery pipeline using NOWPayments, Supabase, and Cloudflare Workers to accept crypto payments and store orders securely. This involves integrating your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages site with the NOWPayments API, configuring your delivery pipeline, and setting up a payment gateway. With these tools in place, you can create a sovereign commerce infrastructure that puts you in control of your own digital store.
By leveraging GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, you can create a decentralized payment and delivery pipeline that puts you in control of your own commerce stack.

If you're looking for a more advanced infrastructure setup, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours with end-to-end testing and 30-day support. You can also check out COREMERCH's products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This post provides a comprehensive guide to building a digital store on Cloudflare Pages, but if you're looking for a turnkey solution, the Edge Commerce Stack is the way to go.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages, follow these steps: Set up a Cloudflare account and a GitHub account. Install the Cloudflare Workers SDK and the NOWPayments SDK on your GitHub repository. Configure your Cloudflare Pages settings to enable Workers and integrate NOWPayments. Deploy your Cloudflare Pages site and configure your Workers settings. Integrate your Cloudflare Pages site with the NOWPayments API and set up a payment gateway. Configure your delivery pipeline to store orders in Supabase. Test your NOWPayments integration and deploy your digital store to the world. Upgrade your Cloudflare Pages plan and configure your Workers settings for load balancing as your store grows in popularity.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 is a basic infrastructure setup that uses GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments to accept crypto payments and store orders. Stack 02, on the other hand, is a more advanced infrastructure setup that uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments to create a scalable and secure digital store. Stack 02 is deployed in 48 hours with end-to-end testing and 30-day support, making it an ideal solution for creators who need a turnkey commerce infrastructure.
Can I use GitHub Pages instead of Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can use GitHub Pages as a hosting platform for your digital store, but you'll need to set up a payment and delivery pipeline using NOWPayments, Supabase, and Cloudflare Workers to accept crypto payments and store orders securely. GitHub Pages is a free hosting platform that's ideal for small projects, but it may not be suitable for larger digital stores that require more advanced infrastructure capabilities.
How do I configure my Workers settings to enable load balancing?

To configure your Workers settings for load balancing, you'll need to set up a load balancer using Cloudflare's built-in load balancing features. This involves creating a load balancer configuration, setting up a routing table, and configuring your Workers to use the load balancer. With load balancing in place, you can distribute traffic across multiple Workers instances to ensure that your digital store remains fast and reliable even under heavy load.
Can I use Supabase instead of a payment gateway?

Yes, you can use Supabase as a database to store orders and customer information, but you'll still need to set up a payment gateway using NOWPayments to accept crypto payments. Supabase is a powerful database platform that's ideal for storing and managing large amounts of data, but it's not designed to process payments. By separating payment processing and order storage, you can create a scalable and secure digital store that meets the needs of your customers.
How do I test my NOWPayments integration?

To test your NOWPayments integration, you'll need to create a test payment using a fake payment method, such as a test credit card. Then, create a test order on your digital store and verify that the payment is processed correctly. With your NOWPayments integration tested, you can deploy your digital store to the world with confidence.
Can I use NOWPayments with other payment gateways?

Yes, you can use NOWPayments with other payment gateways, such as Stripe or PayPal, but you'll need to configure your NOWPayments settings to use the other payment gateway. This involves setting up a payment gateway account, configuring your NOWPayments settings, and testing your integration. With multiple payment gateways supported, you can offer your customers a range of payment options and increase your chances of success.
